verdict.rationale: A state tax agency's online services could plausibly publish an official MCP server, so this question applies to the product. The evidence pack contains only two probes, both recording Akamai HTTP 403 denials for keyless agents at the front door and at the MyFTB/Web Pay host. Neither probe documents any MCP server or other official agent-connection surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
